import { useReducedMotion, useReducedMotionConfig } from 'motion/react'
import { type KeyboardEvent, type PointerEvent, useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'

/** OS setting, or forced on with <MotionConfig reducedMotion="always">. */
function usePrefersReducedMotion() {
  const os = useReducedMotion()
  const forced = useReducedMotionConfig()
  return Boolean(os || forced)
}

// The pen tip trails the pointer on a spring, which irons out the jitter of a hand on a trackpad
// and gives strokes the swing of real ink. Units are px and seconds; the simulation runs at a
// fixed step.
const STEP = 1 / 240
const TIP_STIFFNESS = 2600
const TIP_DAMPING = 78
// Line width follows speed, like a nib: slow is heavy, fast is light.
const MAX_WIDTH = 3.6
const MIN_WIDTH = 1.1
const SPEED_FOR_MIN = 1800
const WIDTH_EASE = 0.08
// A new point is laid down once the tip has moved this far.
const MIN_GAP = 0.6
// Strokes start and end thin, over this many points.
const TAPER = 7
const CLEAR_MS = 420
// Used when the computed color cannot be read (for example outside a browser).
const FALLBACK_INK = 'currentColor'

interface Point {
  x: number
  y: number
  w: number
}

type Stroke = Point[]

function clamp(value: number, min: number, max: number) {
  return Math.min(Math.max(value, min), max)
}

/** Width at point i of a stroke, thinned at both ends. */
function taperedWidth(stroke: Stroke, i: number, open: boolean) {
  const n = stroke.length
  const start = Math.min(1, (i + 1) / TAPER)
  const end = open ? 1 : Math.min(1, (n - i) / TAPER)
  return stroke[i].w * (0.35 + 0.65 * Math.min(start, end))
}

/** Adds a quad to the path, wound the same way as `arc`, so one fill unions them. */
function quad(ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D, pts: number[]) {
  let area = 0
  for (let k = 0; k < 8; k += 2) {
    const j = (k + 2) % 8
    area += pts[k] * pts[j + 1] - pts[j] * pts[k + 1]
  }
  const order = area >= 0 ? [0, 2, 4, 6] : [6, 4, 2, 0]
  ctx.moveTo(pts[order[0]], pts[order[0] + 1])
  for (let k = 1; k < 4; k++) ctx.lineTo(pts[order[k]], pts[order[k] + 1])
  ctx.closePath()
}

/** Draws points [from, to) of a stroke as rounded segments, filled as one shape so joins show no seams. */
function paint(ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D, stroke: Stroke, from: number, to: number, open: boolean) {
  ctx.beginPath()
  for (let i = Math.max(from, 0); i < to; i++) {
    const p = stroke[i]
    // A lone dot gets a little more ink than a taper would give it.
    const w = stroke.length === 1 && !open ? p.w * 0.8 : taperedWidth(stroke, i, open)
    if (i > 0) {
      const q = stroke[i - 1]
      const qw = taperedWidth(stroke, i - 1, open)
      const dx = p.x - q.x
      const dy = p.y - q.y
      const len = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1
      const nx = -dy / len
      const ny = dx / len
      quad(ctx, [
        q.x + (nx * qw) / 2,
        q.y + (ny * qw) / 2,
        p.x + (nx * w) / 2,
        p.y + (ny * w) / 2,
        p.x - (nx * w) / 2,
        p.y - (ny * w) / 2,
        q.x - (nx * qw) / 2,
        q.y - (ny * qw) / 2,
      ])
    }
    ctx.moveTo(p.x + w / 2, p.y)
    ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, w / 2, 0, Math.PI * 2)
  }
  ctx.fill()
}

/** The signature as standalone SVG, one filled outline per stroke. */
function toSvg(strokes: Stroke[], width: number, height: number, ink: string) {
  const paths = strokes
    .map((stroke) => {
      if (stroke.length === 1) {
        const [p] = stroke
        return `<circle cx="${p.x.toFixed(1)}" cy="${p.y.toFixed(1)}" r="${(p.w * 0.4).toFixed(2)}"/>`
      }
      const left: string[] = []
      const right: string[] = []
      for (let i = 0; i < stroke.length; i++) {
        const p = stroke[i]
        const q = stroke[Math.max(i - 1, 0)]
        const r = stroke[Math.min(i + 1, stroke.length - 1)]
        const dx = r.x - q.x
        const dy = r.y - q.y
        const len = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1
        const w = taperedWidth(stroke, i, false) / 2
        left.push(`${(p.x - (dy / len) * w).toFixed(1)} ${(p.y + (dx / len) * w).toFixed(1)}`)
        right.push(`${(p.x + (dy / len) * w).toFixed(1)} ${(p.y - (dx / len) * w).toFixed(1)}`)
      }
      return `<path d="M${left.join('L')}L${right.reverse().join('L')}Z"/>`
    })
    .join('')
  return `<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 ${Math.round(width)} ${Math.round(height)}" fill="${ink}">${paths}</svg>`
}

export interface SignaturePadProps {
  /** Called after each stroke, undo or clear, with the signature as SVG, or null once it is empty. */
  onChange?: (svg: string | null) => void
  /** Accessible name of the drawing area. */
  label?: string
  className?: string
}

/**
 * A pad to sign on with mouse, touch or pen. Ink is sprung and varies with speed. Undo with
 * Ctrl or Cmd+Z, clear with Backspace. The signature comes out as SVG in the foreground color.
 */
export function SignaturePad({ onChange, label = 'Signature', className }: SignaturePadProps) {
  const wrapRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null)
  const [count, setCount] = useState(0)
  const [drawing, setDrawing] = useState(false)
  const [clearing, setClearing] = useState(false)
  const reduced = usePrefersReducedMotion()

  const sim = useRef({
    strokes: [] as Stroke[],
    // Points of the current stroke already on the canvas.
    painted: 0,
    held: false,
    pressure: 0.5,
    usesPressure: false,
    targetX: 0,
    targetY: 0,
    x: 0,
    y: 0,
    vx: 0,
    vy: 0,
    width: MAX_WIDTH,
    raf: 0,
    last: 0,
    carry: 0,
    reduceMotion: false,
    clearing: false,
    size: { width: 0, height: 0 },
  })

  const latest = useRef({ onChange })
  latest.current = { onChange }

  // Reduced motion: the ink goes exactly where the pointer is, and clearing is instant.
  useEffect(() => {
    sim.current.reduceMotion = reduced
  }, [reduced])

  /** The ink is the foreground token, read from the computed style. */
  const ink = useCallback(() => {
    const canvas = canvasRef.current
    return (canvas && getComputedStyle(canvas).color) || FALLBACK_INK
  }, [])

  const context = useCallback(() => {
    const ctx = canvasRef.current?.getContext('2d')
    if (ctx) ctx.fillStyle = ink()
    return ctx ?? null
  }, [ink])

  /** Repaints every stroke, or only the first `fraction` of all the ink. */
  const redraw = useCallback(
    (fraction = 1) => {
      const ctx = context()
      const s = sim.current
      if (!ctx) return
      ctx.clearRect(0, 0, s.size.width, s.size.height)
      const total = s.strokes.reduce((sum, st) => sum + st.length, 0)
      let budget = Math.round(total * fraction)
      for (let k = 0; k < s.strokes.length && budget > 0; k++) {
        const stroke = s.strokes[k]
        const open = s.held && k === s.strokes.length - 1
        paint(ctx, stroke, 0, Math.min(stroke.length, budget), open)
        budget -= stroke.length
      }
    },
    [context],
  )

  const emit = useCallback(() => {
    const s = sim.current
    setCount(s.strokes.length)
    latest.current.onChange?.(s.strokes.length ? toSvg(s.strokes, s.size.width, s.size.height, ink()) : null)
  }, [ink])

  // Size the canvas to its box at the screen's pixel density.
  useEffect(() => {
    const wrap = wrapRef.current
    const canvas = canvasRef.current
    if (!(wrap && canvas)) return
    const s = sim.current
    const fitCanvas = () => {
      const rect = wrap.getBoundingClientRect()
      const dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 3)
      s.size = { width: rect.width, height: rect.height }
      canvas.width = Math.round(rect.width * dpr)
      canvas.height = Math.round(rect.height * dpr)
      canvas.getContext('2d')?.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0)
      redraw()
    }
    fitCanvas()
    const observer = new ResizeObserver(fitCanvas)
    observer.observe(wrap)
    return () => {
      observer.disconnect()
      cancelAnimationFrame(s.raf)
      s.raf = 0
    }
  }, [redraw])

  // One step of the pen: the tip springs towards the pointer, and lays down a point when it has
  // travelled far enough, sized by its speed.
  const stepPen = useCallback(() => {
    const s = sim.current
    const ax = (s.targetX - s.x) * TIP_STIFFNESS - s.vx * TIP_DAMPING
    const ay = (s.targetY - s.y) * TIP_STIFFNESS - s.vy * TIP_DAMPING
    s.vx += ax * STEP
    s.vy += ay * STEP
    s.x += s.vx * STEP
    s.y += s.vy * STEP
    const speed = Math.hypot(s.vx, s.vy)
    const pressure = s.usesPressure ? 0.45 + s.pressure * 0.9 : 1
    const goal = (MAX_WIDTH - (MAX_WIDTH - MIN_WIDTH) * clamp(speed / SPEED_FOR_MIN, 0, 1)) * pressure
    s.width += (goal - s.width) * WIDTH_EASE
    const stroke = s.strokes.at(-1)
    const prev = stroke?.at(-1)
    if (stroke && prev && Math.hypot(s.x - prev.x, s.y - prev.y) >= MIN_GAP) {
      stroke.push({ x: s.x, y: s.y, w: s.width })
    }
    return speed
  }, [])

  /** Stops the pen settling after a lift, leaving the stroke where it is. */
  const stopSettling = useCallback(() => {
    const s = sim.current
    if (!s.raf) return false
    cancelAnimationFrame(s.raf)
    s.raf = 0
    s.last = 0
    s.carry = 0
    return true
  }, [])

  const tick = useCallback(
    (now: number) => {
      const s = sim.current
      s.raf = 0
      const elapsed = s.last ? Math.min((now - s.last) / 1000, 0.05) : STEP
      s.last = now
      s.carry += elapsed
      let speed = 0
      while (s.carry >= STEP) {
        speed = stepPen()
        s.carry -= STEP
      }
      const ctx = context()
      const stroke = s.strokes.at(-1)
      if (ctx && stroke) {
        // Only the new ink; the point before it is repainted to join up.
        paint(ctx, stroke, s.painted - 1, stroke.length, true)
        s.painted = stroke.length
      }
      const caughtUp = Math.hypot(s.targetX - s.x, s.targetY - s.y) < 0.3 && speed < 5
      if (s.held || !caughtUp) {
        s.raf = requestAnimationFrame(tick)
        return
      }
      // The pen has lifted and caught up: close the stroke with its tail taper, and report it.
      s.last = 0
      redraw()
      emit()
    },
    [context, emit, redraw, stepPen],
  )

  const localPoint = (event: PointerEvent) => {
    const rect = wrapRef.current?.getBoundingClientRect()
    return rect ? { x: event.clientX - rect.left, y: event.clientY - rect.top } : { x: 0, y: 0 }
  }

  const handlePointerDown = (event: PointerEvent<HTMLCanvasElement>) => {
    const s = sim.current
    if (clearing || (event.pointerType === 'mouse' && event.button !== 0)) return
    event.preventDefault()
    event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture?.(event.pointerId)
    // Still settling the last stroke: finish it at once.
    if (stopSettling()) emit()
    const p = localPoint(event)
    s.held = true
    s.usesPressure = event.pointerType === 'pen'
    s.pressure = event.pressure || 0.5
    s.x = p.x
    s.y = p.y
    s.targetX = p.x
    s.targetY = p.y
    s.vx = 0
    s.vy = 0
    s.width = MAX_WIDTH
    s.strokes.push([{ x: p.x, y: p.y, w: MAX_WIDTH }])
    s.painted = 0
    redraw()
    setDrawing(true)
    s.raf = requestAnimationFrame(tick)
  }

  const handlePointerMove = (event: PointerEvent<HTMLCanvasElement>) => {
    const s = sim.current
    if (!s.held) return
    const p = localPoint(event)
    s.targetX = p.x
    s.targetY = p.y
    if (s.usesPressure) s.pressure = event.pressure
    if (s.reduceMotion) {
      // No trailing tip: the ink goes exactly where the pointer is.
      s.x = p.x
      s.y = p.y
      s.vx = 0
      s.vy = 0
    }
  }

  const handlePointerUp = () => {
    const s = sim.current
    if (!s.held) return
    s.held = false
    setDrawing(false)
    if (!s.raf) s.raf = requestAnimationFrame(tick)
  }

  const undo = useCallback(() => {
    const s = sim.current
    if (s.held || s.clearing || !s.strokes.length) return
    // Otherwise the settling pen would keep inking the stroke before it.
    stopSettling()
    s.strokes.pop()
    redraw()
    emit()
  }, [emit, redraw, stopSettling])

  // The ink lifts off in the reverse of the order it went down.
  const clear = useCallback(() => {
    const s = sim.current
    if (s.held || s.clearing || !s.strokes.length) return
    stopSettling()
    const done = () => {
      s.strokes = []
      s.clearing = false
      redraw()
      setClearing(false)
      emit()
    }
    if (s.reduceMotion) {
      done()
      return
    }
    s.clearing = true
    setClearing(true)
    const start = performance.now()
    const frame = (now: number) => {
      const t = clamp((now - start) / CLEAR_MS, 0, 1)
      // ease-in-out, so the last strokes do not snap away.
      const eased = t < 0.5 ? 4 * t * t * t : 1 - (-2 * t + 2) ** 3 / 2
      redraw(1 - eased)
      if (t < 1) {
        s.raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame)
      } else {
        s.raf = 0
        done()
      }
    }
    s.raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame)
  }, [emit, redraw, stopSettling])

  const handleKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    if (event.key === 'z' && (event.metaKey || event.ctrlKey)) {
      event.preventDefault()
      undo()
    } else if (event.key === 'Backspace' || event.key === 'Delete') {
      event.preventDefault()
      clear()
    }
  }

  const empty = count === 0 && !drawing
  const action =
    'rounded-md px-2.5 py-1 text-sm text-muted-foreground transition-colors duration-150 ease-out hover:bg-muted hover:text-foreground focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-ring disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-40'

  return (
    // Keyboard shortcuts for undo and clear while the pad has focus.
    // eslint-disable-next-line jsx-a11y/no-static-element-interactions
    <div
      className={cn(
        'w-full max-w-[380px] overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-border bg-card text-foreground select-none',
        className,
      )}
      onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
    >
      <div ref={wrapRef} className="relative h-[200px]">
        {/* The line to sign on. */}
        <div
          aria-hidden="true"
          className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-x-6 bottom-12 flex items-end gap-2 border-b border-border pb-1.5"
        >
          <span className="text-lg leading-none text-muted-foreground">×</span>
          <span
            className={cn(
              'text-sm text-muted-foreground transition-[opacity,filter] duration-200 ease-out',
              empty ? 'opacity-100 blur-0' : 'opacity-0 blur-[2px]',
            )}
          >
            Sign here
          </span>
        </div>
        <canvas
          ref={canvasRef}
          role="img"
          tabIndex={0}
          aria-label={`${label}${count ? `, ${count} stroke${count === 1 ? '' : 's'}` : ', empty'}`}
          className="absolute inset-0 h-full w-full cursor-crosshair touch-none text-foreground focus-visible:-outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-ring"
          onLostPointerCapture={handlePointerUp}
          onPointerCancel={handlePointerUp}
          onPointerDown={handlePointerDown}
          onPointerMove={handlePointerMove}
          onPointerUp={handlePointerUp}
        />
      </div>
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 border-t border-border px-4 py-2.5">
        <p aria-live="polite" className="truncate text-sm text-muted-foreground">
          {count ? 'Signed' : 'Draw your signature'}
        </p>
        <div className="flex shrink-0 gap-1">
          <button type="button" className={action} disabled={!count || clearing} onClick={undo}>
            Undo
          </button>
          <button type="button" className={action} disabled={!count || clearing} onClick={clear}>
            Clear
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

import { useState } from 'react'
import { SignaturePad } from '@/components/signature-pad'

export default function SignaturePadDemo() {
  const [svg, setSvg] = useState<string | null>(null)
  return (
    <div className="flex w-full max-w-[380px] flex-col items-center gap-4">
      <SignaturePad onChange={setSvg} />
      <p className="text-center text-xs text-muted-foreground">
        {svg ? (
          <>
            Captured as SVG, <span className="text-foreground tabular-nums">{svg.length.toLocaleString('en-US')}</span> characters.
          </>
        ) : (
          'Sign above with mouse, touch or pen. Ctrl or Cmd+Z undoes, Backspace clears.'
        )}
      </p>
    </div>
  )
}
